tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: The Secretary may award a grant or cooperative agreement to a public or private nonprofit entity to establish a National Resource Center on Lifespan Respite Care (referred to in this section as the “center”).

children.text: maintain a national database on lifespan respite care;
provide training and technical assistance to State, community, and nonprofit respite care programs; and
provide information, referral, and educational programs to the public on lifespan respite care.
